segments.sn43.12:1.4: Yo, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhataṃ.
segments.sn43.12:1.9: Iti kho, bhikkhave, desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ, desito asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
segments.sn43.12:1.10: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
segments.sn43.12:1.11: Etāni, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamādattha; mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
segments.sn43.12:2.4: Yo, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhataṃ.
segments.sn43.12:2.9: Iti kho, bhikkhave, desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ … pe … ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
segments.sn43.12:3.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:3.6: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:3.8: Avitakko avicāro samādhi. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe ….
segments.sn43.12:4.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:4.6: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:4.8: Appaṇihito samādhi. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe ….
segments.sn43.12:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
segments.sn43.12:5.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:5.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:5.8: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu citte cittānupassī … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:5.11: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe ….
segments.sn43.12:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.sn43.12:6.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:6.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.sn43.12:6.6: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:6.8: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.sn43.12:6.9: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:6.11: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe ….
segments.sn43.12:7.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn43.12:7.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:7.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vīriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn43.12:7.6: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:7.8: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn43.12:7.9: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:7.11: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vīmaṃsasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe ….
segments.sn43.12:8.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn43.12:8.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:8.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vīriyindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:8.8: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satindriyaṃ bhāveti … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:8.11: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu samādhindriyaṃ bhāveti … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:8.14: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paññindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe ….
segments.sn43.12:9.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhābalaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:9.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vīriyabalaṃ bhāveti … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:9.8: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satibalaṃ bhāveti … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:9.11: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu samādhibalaṃ bhāveti … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:9.14: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paññābalaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe ….
segments.sn43.12:10.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe … ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:10.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe … vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe … pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe … passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe … samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn43.12:11.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn43.12:11.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, asaṅkhatagāmimaggo?
segments.sn43.12:11.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammāsaṅkappaṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāvācaṃ bhāveti … pe … sammākammantaṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāājīvaṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāvāyāmaṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāsatiṃ bhāveti … pe … asaṅkhatañca vo bhikkhave, desessāmi asaṅkhatagāmiñca maggaṃ.
segments.sn43.12:11.15: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn43.12:11.17: Iti kho, bhikkhave, desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ, desito asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
segments.sn43.12:11.18: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
segments.sn43.12:11.19: Etāni, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamādattha; mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī”ti.

lines: 377-409. Kāye kāyānupassītiādīsu yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ parato vakkhāma.
Abhūtameva bhūtaṃ ajātaṃ hutvā atthīti vā abbhutaṃ.
Natthi ettha dukkhanti niddukkhaṃ, tassa bhāvo niddukkhattaṃ.
Patiṭṭhaṭṭhenāti patiṭṭhābhāvena vaṭṭadukkhato muccitukāmānaṃ dīpasadisaṃ oghehi anajjhottharaṇīyattā.
